notes.title: New Twisty's Asylum Escapades Update!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26227882/3b8d900ac9db11f8861ada94de8428250044f975.jpg

Happy Halloween!

We've got an update for Twisty's Asylum Escapades for you.
It features improvements based on some of the feedback we've gotten so far; including:


A new "Insane" difficulty level
Modified existing difficulty levels for better gameplay
Improvements to some of the texture/graphic effects
Positive modifications to how you obtain achievements
More flexible saving and loading capabilities
New variation/method for how you can beat the game
 

Have fun playing this strangely compelling floating killer brain game and never hesitate to let us know what else you'd like to see!
